accordions: Collapsible content sections with click-to-toggle headers, smooth animations, and chevron/icon indicators.
avatars: Profile images with circular layout, text/initials fallback, and stacking support for multiple users.
backgrounds: Full-bleed animated backdrops: shaders, auroras, flowing patterns, dithering, and canvas effects for hero screens.
badges: Small label tags with icons, counts, and rounded variants for status or category marking.
borders: Animated border effects: pulsing glows, lightning traces, sparkles, and bright beams traversing edges.
buttons: Buttons and CTAs from plain variants through gradient, shimmer, metal, beam and animated treatments.
calendar: Date pickers and calendar widgets with month navigation, range selection, and disabled-date handling.
cards: Card layouts with 3D tilts, hover animations, pixel reveals, holographic effects, and scroll-based stacking.
carousels: Scrollable card stacks with 3D rotation, drag navigation, autoplay, and modal detail views.
checkboxes: Checkboxes, indeterminate states, toggle groups, and radio button variants with state sync.
data-display: Animated counters, number animators, scroll-triggered sequences, and spring-based value transitions.
effects: 3D transformations, particle systems, light beams, bouncing physics, and canvas-based visual effects.
file-upload: Image/file upload with drag-drop, preview thumbnails, and inline attachment display.
footers: Full-width footer layouts with navigation, social links, branding, and theme variants.
forms: Login/register tabbed forms with OAuth providers and email/password authentication.
gradients: Animated gradient wrappers with flowing colors, radial effects, and transitions through named color schemes.
heroes: Full-screen hero sections with shader backdrops, staggered text animations, and interactive elements.
inputs: Color pickers, email inputs, and text fields with helpers, icons, validation, and HSL/Hex controls.
loaders: Circular progress bars, step loaders, and multi-stage loading indicators with animations.
media: 3D galleries, marquee carousels, image grids, globe viewers, and masonry layouts with effects.
misc: About sections, company stories, value highlights, and miscellaneous landing page content blocks.
modals: Alerts, drawers, command palettes, search modals, and springy dialogs with backdrop blur.
navigation: Navbars, menus, docks, sidebars with hover animations, submenus, and gooey fill effects.
notifications: Alert toasts and inline notifications with status badges, icons, and color-coded warning/error variants.
pricing: Pricing tier selectors with radio buttons, popular badges, and animated timeline components.
selects: Dropdown menus with icons, helpers, colored borders, and searchable option lists.
sliders: Range sliders, balance sliders, single-thumb controls, and bouncy/elastic release animations.
tables: Data tables with rows, columns, avatars, alternating backgrounds, dividers, and rounded corners.
testimonials: Rotating testimonial carousels with image stacks, text reveals, and infinite scroll directions.
text: Animated text effects: ASCII art waves, blur reveals, orbiting letters, curved paths, and decryption.
tooltips: Hover tooltips with styling variants, arrow pointers, tilt effects, and avatar stack integration.
